title: A 3D voxel game engine written in APL
summary: A experimental 3D voxel game engine implemented entirely in APL (A Programming Language), an array-oriented language traditionally used for mathematical computation. The project demonstrates that APL can be stretched beyond its typical use cases into real-time 3D graphics rendering, though at 56 points on Hacker News, it represents a novel proof-of-concept rather than a production-ready engine.
problem_solved: Demonstrates the unconventional use of APL for game development and 3D graphics rendering, pushing the boundaries of what array-oriented languages can accomplish.
why_valuable: Provides a unique educational resource showing alternative applications of APL and inspires creative thinking about programming language capabilities beyond their traditional domains.
